notes: Cumulative visual Timeline release on stable v0.2.21. Replaces the old single Life / Story Timeline text box with repeatable structured events containing Event Name, When type/value, Event Type, Importance, Notes, and optional End. Adds a scrollable chronological visual timeline, manual up/down ordering for uncertain events, zoom controls, per-event randomization, and whole-timeline randomization. Preserves Story, Powers, bootstrap updater, relaunch-loop fix, both runnable and compressed core files, and separate user data. Windows PowerShell parsing and package/hash validation passed before publish.
